_comment: DATA AXIS, varying rule. The rung where the rule is genuinely unseen, and
therefore the closest thing in this repo to an in-context-learning test.
subst-fst redraws the substitution map PER INSTANCE (pinned by a test in
src/tasks/fst.rs, so the two rungs cannot silently converge). k_set is
[1,2,3,5] with k0_rate 0, so the map is DEMONSTRATED in the prompt every
time and the model has to induce it rather than recall it.
k_set matters enormously here and has already caused one wrong result: a
first pass inherited k_set [0] from the constant-rule base, measured the
same numbers, and was reported as 'at chance on unseen rules'. With no
demonstration there is nothing in the prompt to induce a map FROM, so that
configuration could not have supported the claim. Never report a rule-
